source: During autoregressive decoding, each step creates only one new query position per sequence, while the model repeatedly attends over an ever-growing prefix. The previously computed K/V tensors must be available for every step. Shazeer’s ZXNAME0000XZ paper identified the repeated loading of these large K/V tensors as a major memory-bandwidth cost of incremental decoding.ZXMATH0000XZ
zh: 在自回归解码过程中，每个步骤仅为每个序列创建一个新的查询位置，而模型会重复关注不断增长的前缀。先前计算的 K/V 张量必须可用于每个步骤。 Shazeer 的 ZXNAME0000XZ 论文将这些大型 K/V 张量的重复加载确定为增量解码的主要内存带宽成本。ZXMATH0000XZ
